currentContext.expansion: The annual report contains no capex project, capacity-addition, commissioning or ramp-up disclosure. Expansion is described entirely as market, product and channel build-out rather than physical capacity. The Company states it has started its journey to transform itself from a ghee company into a food conglomerate. Under Product Expansion it manufactures and markets under the brands Naman, Godhenu, Nutri Flakes, Sweet Bites, Yumm Yoo and Polki, with a portfolio spanning Buffalo Ghee, Cow Ghee, A2 Gir Cow Ghee, Premium Buffalo Ghee, Kesar, Poha, Mangodi, Papad, Refined Groundnut Oil, Pasta, chutneys, Chai Masala and Poha Masala, Indian Spices, Chilla Pre Mix and Rava Idli Mix. Under Market Expansion it says it has created a market leadership position in the branded ghee segment in Rajasthan, is making its presence in Hyderabad, Jammu & Kashmir, Madhya Pradesh and Uttarakhand, and is gradually opening in Delhi, Haryana, Maharashtra, Gujarat, West Bengal and Bangalore, supported by trade fairs, distributor and caterer meets, hoardings, print media, canopies and online marketplaces, while increasing institutional sales through corporate clients including Haldiram's, Ghasitaram's, Baidyanath, Bikaji, Bhika Ram Chandmal, Prashant Corner, Dabur, Om Sweets, Bikano and Dadu's Sweet. It intends to leverage modern retail, e-commerce and digital marketplaces by strengthening its product portfolio, enhancing distribution capabilities and improving consumer engagement, while balancing expansion initiatives with operational efficiency and cost optimization. The only board-approved forward step with a date is the Board meeting of 16th June 2026 approving, subject to member approval, an alteration of the Main Object Clause of the Memorandum of Association to enable new business activities in edible oils, vegetable and cooking oils and oil-based products; cattle, animal and poultry feed, feed supplements, ingredients and fodder; and saffron, spices, herbs and agricultural produce - stated to provide greater flexibility to diversify operations, explore new markets and create opportunities for future growth and expansion, and to be in line with the business plans and strategic objectives of the Company. The two existing manufacturing units named in the Corporate Overview are Road No. 6, V.K.I, Jaipur (Desi Ghee, Cow Ghee) and Beechhwal Industrial Area, Bikaner (Polki Groundnut Refined Oil); no capacity figures are given for either.

risks.risk: Qualified audit opinion arising from an NPA-classified credit facility and a pending DRT recovery suit
risks.note: The statutory auditor has issued a Qualified Opinion on the FY26 financial statements. The basis for qualification is the Company's decision not to provision for interest on the credit facility from Axis Bank and Acme Resources Pvt. Ltd., on the ground that the account is classified as a Non-Performing Asset and RBI guidelines allow interest on NPAs to be booked only on receipt. Axis Bank has initiated a recovery suit before the Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT) in Jaipur, which is still pending; the auditor states the outcome may influence the Company's financial reporting and provisioning practices and that the financial implications are yet to be determined. This is the single most material structural risk in the report - it puts the Company's lender relationship, its access to credit and the reported carrying of interest liability all in question.

risks.risk: Procurement risk on agri and allied natural raw materials
risks.note: Management flags that adequate and uninterrupted availability of key raw materials at the right prices is crucial. Raw materials are agri and allied natural products, so production depends on the vagaries of nature; any supply disruption from a natural or other calamity, or violent changes in the cost structure, could adversely affect the Company's ability to reach its consumers with the right value proposition. The MD&A separately notes the sector is capital intensive with a high working-capital requirement because of the seasonal nature of raw material.

risks.risk: Competition from branded multinational and Indian majors with deep pockets
risks.note: Management states the branded segment of the Indian food industry is dominated by a few multinational and Indian majors with deep pockets, whose heavy investment on network and brand strengthening, or any probability of a price war, poses risk to the Company. The MD&A SWOT also lists big competitors with aligned product portfolios as a threat.

risks.risk: Competition from the unorganized loose / unbranded segment
risks.note: Management flags the presence of an unorganized sector offering products in loose/unbranded form which intensifies competition. The MD&A adds that there are no barriers to entry, leading to the emergence of new competitors at both local and national level, and that kirana and other traditional stores still make up more than 95% of India's food stores.

Management flags that any sudden change in food security policy and other regulations may hit profit margins badly. As a food manufacturer the Company is exposed to FSSAI and food-safety standards; it states it abides by government food security policies and moves products through adequate quality-checking procedures.

Management identifies as a challenge the huge investments required to set up a distribution network and promote brands: with a growth strategy of expanding product range and customer and geographical reach, it needs to invest in a strong distribution network and to make substantial investments in brand building. It further notes that advertisement and promotional spending in the FMCG/packaged food industry needs to be quite aggressive, which is a structural drag on margins for a company of this size.

risks.risk: Single-segment and single-category concentration with a Rajasthan-centred footprint
risks.note: The Company reports only one reportable business segment - manufacturing of food products such as different types of ghee, Chai Masala, Spice Mixes and Poha Masala, alongside marketing of Saffron, Poha, Pasta, Quinoa Pasta, Groundnut Oil, Papad and A2 Ghee. Ghee is described as one of its strongest categories and its stated market leadership position is specifically in the branded ghee segment in Rajasthan, with other states still being opened. Earnings are therefore concentrated in one category and one home state, leaving little internal offset if ghee demand, ghee input costs or the Rajasthan market turns.

risks.risk: Inadequate cold-chain, storage and transportation infrastructure
risks.note: Management flags that development of the processed food industry depends on infrastructure facilities such as storage and transportation, and that the country still needs to develop such primary facilities a lot. The MD&A weaknesses list adds a lack of adequate power, road and rail connectivity and storage, and a large number of supply-chain intermediaries leading to wastage and price rise at each level - which for a perishable dairy portfolio bears directly on quality claims and cost.
